literal_meaning: পায়ে মাড়ানো বা চাপা পড়া (trampled or crushed underfoot)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঝড়ে ফসলগুলো পুরোপুরি পয়মাল হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The crops were completely ruined by the storm.
His dreams have been trampled into nothingness.
note: The idiom often evokes imagery of natural calamities affecting rural life in Bengal.
